gloss: when one's stomach is empty; on an empty stomach

definitions.gloss: when one's stomach is empty; on an empty stomach
definitions.explanation: The time or state of having an empty stomach. Frequently used in medical and pharmaceutical instructions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空腹時|くうふくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take this medicine on an empty stomach.

examples.japanese: {空腹時|くうふくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}く→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Drinking coffee on an empty stomach gives me a stomachache.

examples.japanese: {空腹時|くうふくじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{血糖値|けっとうち}→血糖値：19493_kettouchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がり→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Exercise on an empty stomach can easily lower blood sugar, so caution is needed.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧ (empty stomach, hunger) and ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (time, when). Very common on medicine packaging and in medical instructions. The opposite is ⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧ (after meals).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空腹時|くうふくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧ (to take medicine on an empty stomach)
- {空腹時|くうふくじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{血糖値|けっとうち}→血糖値：19493_kettouchi⟧ (fasting blood sugar level)
- {空腹時|くうふくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink on an empty stomach)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{食前|しょくぜん}→食前：20726_shokuzen⟧: before meals
- ⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧: after meals
- {食間|しょっかん}: between meals
